[Dwayne Johnson](https://fandomwire.com/tag/dwayne-johnson/), aka The Rock’s has built up an impressive animated movie career that is literally like a quirky side quest in his diverse career. We have this charismatic guy known for lifting entire franchises on his back, suddenly trading his action stunts for a mic and a character with 2D or CGI swagger. Isn’t it brilliant to think about it? There are no green screens, just green rooms with sound booths.
Well, Johnson’s voice has powered some of the most memorable animated characters in recent years, from a self-obsessed demigod teaching kids the art of the humble brag to a super-powered canine with an undeniable hero complex.
Honestly, Johnson’s animated gigs have proved that his charm isn’t just a physical thing; it lands with comedic timing sharper than a wrestling takedown. So, let’s rank all of Dwayne Johnson’s animated movies, from the ones that made us want to build a shrine for Maui to the ones that made us question if The Rock could save the script. The entries on this list are ranked based on the characters’ impact and performance. 
##  6 _Zootopia 2_ (Zeke)
[ × Remove Ads ](https://fandomwire.com/membership/)
![Zeke, as seen in zootopia 2](https://fwmedia.fandomwire.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/21025120/zeke-zootopia-2.png)Zeke in _Zootopia 2_ | Credits: Walt Disney Animation Studios
In _[Zootopia 2](https://fandomwire.com/tag/zootopia-2/)_ , Dwayne Johnson lends his voice to Zeke, a hilarious new addition to the franchise. Although the highly anticipated sequel features plenty of animal antics, Johnson’s small yet commendable performance as Zeke, a male dik-dik, brings a dose of comedy to the film’s narrative. With Johnson’s familiar deep rumble, Zeke fits right into the franchise’s universe. 
[ × Remove Ads ](https://fandomwire.com/membership/)
In fact, Zeke’s character goes to show that The Rock isn’t only suited for action-hero type voices. Rather, his comedic timing (something we have already seen in _Jumanji_) is on point. Especially, Zeke’s rapid-fire banter with the cast exudes Johnson’s signature charm. However, the role was too small to be ranked higher. Even though it was impactful, it could have been a bit longer. 
##  5 _Planet 51_ (Captain Charles T. Baker)
![A still from Planet 51](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%271024%27%20height%3D%27576%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%201024%20576%27%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E)Dwayne Johnson in _Planet 51_ | Credits: Ilion Animation Studios/HandMade Films International
In _[Planet 51](https://fandomwire.com/tag/planet-51/)_ , Dwayne Johnson ditches his usual action-hero vibe that we all know him for to voice Captain Charles T. Baker, a cocky NASA astronaut who lands on a planet full of retro-futuristic green aliens. As Chuck thinks he’s the ultimate space explorer, his swagger quickly turns into sheer panic when he realizes he’s the ultimate space explorer.
With Johnson’s deep voice, Chuck’s character comes naturally with bravado and cluelessness, making him an oddly endearing invader who’s a hero and a walking disaster.
[ Related![dwayne johnson still cant score a win as fans unhappy with his moana update for disney](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%27768%27%20height%3D%27432%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%20768%20432%27%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E) “It hasn’t been even a decade”: Dwayne Johnson Still Can’t Score a Win as Fans Unhappy With His Moana Update for Disney](https://fandomwire.com/it-hasnt-been-even-a-decade-dwayne-johnson-still-cant-score-a-win-as-fans-unhappy-with-his-moana-update-for-disney/)
Johnson’s Chuck teams up with Lem, a nerdy alien teen, and Rover, a dog-like robot, and his journey is a chaotic race against time to escape the military’s bizarre sci-fi paranoia. While Johnson’s comedic timing truly shines as Chuck, showcasing the kooky 1950s-inspired alien world, his dad-joke energy was attention-grabbing. Unfortunately, [_Planet 51_ is one of those films that couldn’t become a franchise](https://fandomwire.com/5-notorious-dwayne-johnson-bombs-that-failed-to-become-franchises/), primarily because the movie didn’t soar with critics. As such, it’s ranked fifth on this list.
##  4 _Once Upon a Studio_ (Maui)
![A still from Once Upon a Studio](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%271024%27%20height%3D%27576%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%201024%20576%27%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E)Dwayne Johnson as Maui in _Once Upon a Studio_ | Credits- Walt Disney Animation Studios
Dwayne Johnson brings his iconic voice back as Maui in _Once Upon a Studio_ , adding his signature charisma to Disney’s 100th-anniversary celebration. This delightful short film unites characters from [Disney’s](https://fandomwire.com/tag/disney/) century-long history, blending live-action, traditional animation, and CGI into a magical tribute. Johnson’s Maui perfectly blended alongside classic icons like Mickey Mouse and contemporary stars like Mirabel from Encanto.
##  3 _DC League of Super-Pets_ (Krypto, Anubis, Black Adam)
![A still from DC League of Super-Pets](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%271024%27%20height%3D%27576%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%201024%20576%27%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E)Dwayne Johnson as Krypto in _DC League of Super-Pets_ | Credits- Warner Bros.
It’s proven that Dwayne Johnson doesn’t just rock the big screen; he owns the animated world, too. In _[DC League of Super-Pets](https://fandomwire.com/tag/dc-league-of-super-pets/)_ , Johnson flexes his vocal muscles as Krypto, Superman’s super-loyal (and super-powered) Labrador, delivering a mix of humor, heart, and heroic barks. But wait, there’s more, he doubles up as Black Adam’s brooding pup, Anubis, for a cheeky post-credits cameo that pokes fun at his live-action antihero gig.
[ Related![dwayne johnson 2](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%27768%27%20height%3D%27432%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%20768%20432%27%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E) “The Rock as Apocalypse is gonna happen now”: Dwayne Johnson Can Leave Black Adam Behind and Join MCU After His Lucrative Disney Contract](https://fandomwire.com/the-rock-as-apocalypse-is-gonna-happen-now-dwayne-johnson-can-leave-black-adam-behind-and-join-mcu-after-his-lucrative-disney-contract/)
Johnson’s voice work isn’t just about gruff tones and epic one-liners; it’s the playful nuances he brings to Krypto, balancing his larger-than-life superhero vibe with the relatable jealousy of Superman’s love life. And not to mention his chemistry with Kevin Hart (as the feisty Ace) is pure comedy gold, proving their banter translates seamlessly from live-action to animation.

Whether saving the Justice League or chasing engagement rings, Johnson’s vocal performance brings an energy that’s part demigod, part dog dad. It’s official, The Rock’s voice has just as much star power as his blockbuster biceps. Bark Kent, anyone?
##  2 _Moana_(Maui)
![A still from Moana featuring Dwayne Johnson](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%271024%27%20height%3D%27576%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%201024%20576%27%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E)Dwayne Johnson as Maui in _Moana_ | Credits- Walt Disney Animation Studios
Dwayne Johnson in _[Moana](https://fandomwire.com/tag/moana/) _was truly a tidal wave of charm and charisma. He voiced Maui, the demigod with an ego as big as the ocean, and as his personality goes, he added a dose of humor and heart to the role. Not to mention his iconic voice, it made him more than just a tattooed hero. And let’s not forget, “You’re Welcome,” the catchy-as-heck anthem that proves The Rock can belt out tunes just as effortlessly as he body-slams villains in action flicks.
[ Related![moana 2 dwayne johnson](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%27768%27%20height%3D%27432%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%20768%20432%27%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E) Moana 2 Budget and Cast Salary: Forget Dwayne Johnson, His Daughters Will Carry Home a Massive Paycheck for Their Role in the Sequel](https://fandomwire.com/moana-2-budget-and-cast-salary-forget-dwayne-johnson-his-daughters-will-carry-home-a-massive-paycheck-for-their-role-in-the-sequel/)
Besides, Johnson’s comedic timing and vocal flair made Maui relatable, even when he was strutting around as a hero extraordinaire. Whether you’re team “Maui is misunderstood” or “he needs an attitude check,” there’s no denying Johnson made the role unforgettable, leaving us all singing along, like it or not.
##  1 _Moana 2_ (Maui)
![A still from Moana 2](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%271024%27%20height%3D%27576%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%201024%20576%27%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E)Dwayne Johnson as Maui in _Moana 2_ | Credits- Walt Disney Animation Studios
Dwayne Johnson is back as Maui, the shapeshifting demigod with charm as big as his muscles, in _[Moana 2](https://fandomwire.com/tag/moana-2)_. Picking up three years after the first film’s high-seas adventure, this sequel sees Maui teaming up with Moana once again, but this time to tackle a cursed, sunken island, a storm god named Nalo, and some seriously dramatic oceanic antics. Of course, Johnson’s booming voice infuses Maui with the perfect mix of sass, wisdom, and reluctant hero vibes, making every line unforgettable.
[ Related![moana 2 box office dwayne johnson](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%27768%27%20height%3D%27432%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%20768%20432%27%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E) Moana 2 Box Office Record Makes Dwayne Johnson the Undisputed Thanksgiving King](https://fandomwire.com/moana-2-box-office-record-makes-dwayne-johnson-the-undisputed-thanksgiving-king/)
In _Moana 2_ , Moana leads a ragtag crew, including a Maui superfan and some familiar feathered and snouted sidekicks, as they face off against pirates, monsters, and even death itself. Johnson’s Maui gets his moment to shine, lifting islands and spirits alike, but also faces his doubts. With stunning visuals, catchy tunes, and Maui’s unbeatable swagger, [_Moana 2_ is a whirlwind of adventure](https://fandomwire.com/moana-2-review/) that feels like a big ol’ Maui hug: epic, heartfelt, and just the right amount of cocky.

Here are some answers to a few common questions you may have: 
### How many animated movies has Dwayne Johnson voiced?
As of May 2026, Johnson has major voice roles in four theatrical films, plus a couple of cameos. 
### Does Dwayne Johnson have any new animated movies coming soon?
No major animated leads are confirmed for the 2026-2027 timeline. 
### Is Zootopia 2 considered a full movie for Johnson?
No, Johnson has made a cameo as Zeke in the film, and it’s only for comedic purposes. Therefore, it’s not considered a full length animated movie for him.
